postReview.title: Manchester United 0-1 Manchester City: Contentious Haaland finish settles dramatic derby
postReview.description: Manchester City had Phil Foden sent off at Old Trafford, but a contentious goal from Erling Haaland saw them beat Manchester United 1-0.

postReview.title: Manchester United 0-1 Manchester City: golo polémico de Haaland decide um dérbi dramático
